modmenu.descriptionTranslation.ernst: Custom lighting in the style of Mirror's Edge: colored AO, custom lightmap and sky, bloom, volumetric rays and shadows.
text.ernst.hud.title: eRnsT Renderer
text.ernst.config.title: eRnsT Settings
text.ernst.preset.tip: Overall look. Changing it resets all look-related sliders to the preset's values.
text.ernst.quality.tip: Quickly sets bloom, rays, shadows and light radius for the desired FPS.
text.ernst.enabled.tip: Master switch for all eRnsT effects (hotkey: O).
text.ernst.light_radius.tip: How far custom lighting effects are processed.
text.ernst.notification.tip: Show a popup and chat message when toggling the mod.
text.ernst.lightmap.tip: Replaces the vanilla light colors with eRnsT's.
text.ernst.sky.tip: Replaces the vanilla sky and fog colors.
text.ernst.terrain_effect.tip: Strength of colored ambient occlusion and texture simplification.
text.ernst.ao_contrast.tip: How dark the ambient occlusion in corners is.
text.ernst.shade_ns.tip: Brightness of faces pointing north and south.
text.ernst.shade_we.tip: Brightness of faces pointing west and east.
text.ernst.shade_tint.tip: How strongly shaded areas are tinted blue.
text.ernst.light_cool.tip: Strength of the cool tone in weak lighting.
text.ernst.light_warmth.tip: Strength of the warm tone of torches and other light sources.
text.ernst.light_contrast.tip: Contrast between lit and dark areas.
text.ernst.rain_darken.tip: How much the sky darkens during rain.
text.ernst.vibrance.tip: Boosts only dull colors, leaving vivid ones alone.
text.ernst.contrast.tip: Difference between light and dark areas.
text.ernst.warmth.tip: Negative values make the image cooler, positive values warmer.
text.ernst.tone_shoulder.tip: Where highlight compression starts. Lower values are softer.
text.ernst.bloom_enabled.tip: When off, bloom is skipped entirely (saves FPS).
text.ernst.rays_enabled.tip: When off, sun rays and volumetric fog are skipped entirely (saves FPS).
text.ernst.light_rays.tip: Rays from torches, lava and portals.
text.ernst.light_ray_strength.tip: Brightness of rays from light sources.
text.ernst.bloom_strength.tip: Intensity of the glow around bright areas.
text.ernst.bloom_threshold.tip: Brightness above which glow appears. Higher means less glow.
text.ernst.light_boost.tip: Extra brightness for light sources before bloom.
text.ernst.entity_bloom.tip: Apply bloom to mobs and other entities.
text.ernst.ray_strength.tip: Intensity of the sun's light shafts.
text.ernst.ray_length.tip: How far the light shafts extend.
text.ernst.fog_height.tip: Altitude (Y level) below which the fog sits.
text.ernst.fog_falloff.tip: How quickly the fog thins out with height.
text.ernst.fog_sun.tip: How strongly the sun lights up the fog.
text.ernst.shadows_enabled.tip: Shadows cast by blocks. Heavy on FPS.
text.ernst.shadow_range.tip: Radius around the player covered by the shadow map.
text.ernst.shadow_high_res.tip: 2048 instead of 1024. Sharper shadows, lower FPS.
text.ernst.shadows_nether.tip: Only tall structures cast shadows in the Nether.
text.ernst.nether_height.tip: Structures higher than this above the player cast no shadows.
text.ernst.shadows_end.tip: Enable shadows in the End dimension.
